xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5481: docs: voice and text-to-speech

references.label: PAN-5204 /ws/voice sample rates and AutoPreso leak
PAN-5574 tts.rate ignored by the daemon
PAN-5575 Voice Map keys nothing emits
PAN-5576 Moonshine sidecar missing on npm installs
PAN-5577 unused Voice device and volume settings
PAN-5578 stale pan-tts skill and event-stream doc

narratives.Problem: No published page explains voice. reference/settings.mdx says 'Not documented yet' for the Voice and TTS rows, the only TTS doc is the pan tts command table, and the pan-tts skill carries stale facts (port 3000, a private ~/Projects/pan-tts subscriber, 2048-dim embeddings). Users cannot learn how to dictate, what tts.enabled needs, which hardware the Qwen3-TTS daemon needs, or how voices are chosen.
narratives.Proposal: Create configuration/voice.mdx with the exact text in the PRD (.pan/drafts/PAN-5481.md, W1): composer dictation (mic button, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+M, Edit and Direct modes, limits), Settings → Voice and the Moonshine sidecar limits, how TTS works and its Linux/CUDA/PipeWire needs, setup steps, keeping the daemon running, voices (preset, design, clone; System and Status Voice), every tts.* control and the emitted event types, the summarizer, external sidecars via /events/stream and the token-protected daemon /speak, troubleshooting, known issues linking the filed bugs, and Get help. Add it to docs.json after configuration/appearance and link it from reference/settings.mdx, the pan tts section of cli/core-commands.mdx and the AutoPreso section of features/dashboard-views.mdx. Validate with npm run lint:docs and mint@4.3.49 validate, broken-links and broken-links --check-anchors.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code changes; #5204, #5574, #5575, #5576 and #5577 are fixed separately.
- No edits to sync-sources/skills/pan-tts/SKILL.md or docs/EXTERNAL-EVENT-STREAM.md; #5578 tracks them.
- No new screenshots and no reuse of images/dashboard/settings-*.png.
- No changes to other rows of reference/settings.mdx or to the pan tts command table.
- No mention of the private ~/Projects/pan-tts subscriber, ~/.pan-tts/config.yaml, port 3000 or scripts/say.sh on the page.
- No fixes to the 3 pre-existing anchor breaks in features/skills.mdx and guides/docker-setup.mdx.
- No changelog.d entry (no behavior change).

autoDecisions.summary: Create one page, configuration/voice.mdx, placed in the docs.json Configuration group directly after configuration/appearance.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names configuration/voice.mdx; voice is a per-user preference like Appearance, so it sits next to it.

autoDecisions.summary: Name controls that do nothing (Rate, Settings Voice Map and Utterance Templates keys, Voice device fields) and the Moonshine npm gap in one sentence each with the filed issue link, plus a short Known issues section, instead of leaving them out.
autoDecisions.rationale: The page lists every setting; describing Rate as a speed control or the Voice Map as working would be a false claim, and the epic requires every claim to match current code.

autoDecisions.summary: File #5574, #5575, #5576, #5577 and #5578 for the bugs found during research and fix none of them here.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue is docs-only; PAN-5480 set the precedent of filing bugs found while documenting (#5543).

autoDecisions.summary: Document the 18 event types (from 16 emitActivityTts call sites) Overdeck emits and tell users to set voiceMap and utteranceTemplates with pan tts voices map or the config file.
autoDecisions.rationale: No emitter uses the issueState.* and attention.* keys the Settings UI offers (#5575), so only the emitted types work.

autoDecisions.summary: Describe external sidecars only as two interfaces: GET /events/stream?types=activity.tts and the token-protected daemon POST /speak.
autoDecisions.rationale: Overdeck ships no sidecar; the subscriber SKILL.md describes is a private local project (eltmon/pan-tts does not exist).
No image under images/ shows the voice panel or the Voice or TTS settings, and the issue forbids invented UI.

autoDecisions.summary: Fold validation (lint:docs, mint validate, broken-links, --check-anchors) into every item instead of a separate validation item.
autoDecisions.rationale: Validation changes no file, so it cannot carry its own Item: commit; PAN-5480's plan did the same.

autoDecisions.summary: Tell users that CLI and config-file changes to tts settings reach a running dashboard only after `pan restart`, in a 'When changes apply' subsection.
autoDecisions.rationale: refreshTtsRuntimeConfig runs only at boot, on a Settings save and on a model-preset apply; pan tts voices set-default and map write config.yaml only.
